name: Road Construction Department, Government of Bihar
summary: The state department that builds and maintains Bihar's state highways, major district roads and bridges.
about: Bihar keeps its roads under a dedicated Road Construction Department. The state is criss-crossed by large rivers — the Ganga, the Gandak, the Kosi — so a great deal of its road building is really bridge building, and floods in north Bihar cut roads every year.
facts: Responsible for Bihar's state highways and major district roads.
Also looks after most state-owned bridges and government buildings.
National highways in the state are not its responsibility — those belong to NHAI, NHIDCL or the state's national highway wing.
